_about: Pass 128 (lane ENV): five new named variations of each of the 21 scenery prop kinds, candidates only (nothing here is in the game). Painted by tools/gen_env_variations.py, laid out for Garry by tools/make_env_variants.py (docs/env_variants/index.html). `kinds[base].ref` is the original's own raw render in tools/dl/ai_raw_props (the style reference; a row whose shape must differ from the original's says `"ref": null`: the painter copies a reference's silhouette, so those are painted from the style anchor and the words alone, as joshua_tree_b and _d were); a row is {id, base, name, subject, seed}: `name` is what Garry says aloud, `subject` the painter's words (gen_props.NO_FACE is added), seeds are seed + k*977. A cart row also names its Blender render (`render`, tools/blender_cart_states.py).

rows.name: Old Giant
rows.subject: a giant old saguaro cactus with many branches: a very thick tall ribbed green trunk carrying six thick curved branches, three on its left side and three on its right side at different heights, all bending upwards like a huge candelabra, small spines

rows.name: Lone Spear
rows.subject: a single tall cactus pillar: one straight unbranched ribbed green column with a rounded top standing alone like a giant upright cucumber, perfectly plain sides, small spines

rows.name: Crown Bloom
rows.subject: a tall green saguaro cactus with two upraised arms, in bloom: a crown of white flowers with yellow centres on the top of the trunk and on the tip of each arm, ribbed, small spines

rows.name: Drooping Arm
rows.subject: a tall green saguaro cactus with one thick arm raised up on one side and one long arm on the other side bending down and drooping towards the ground, ribbed, small spines

rows.name: Broken Top
rows.subject: an old damaged saguaro cactus: the top of the tall ribbed trunk snapped off, leaving a ragged broken end with pale dry woody ribs sticking out, one green arm still raised below the break, small spines, a brown dry scar on the trunk

rows.name: Leaning Pup
rows.subject: a young cactus pup: one short thick unbranched ribbed green column with a rounded top, plain sides, leaning over to one side, small spines

rows.name: Budding Arms
rows.subject: one plain unbranched ribbed green cactus pillar with a rounded top, like an upright cucumber, with two small round green bumps on its sides half way up, one on the left and one on the right, small spines

rows.name: Twin Stems
rows.subject: two plain green cactus pillars standing close side by side and touching at the foot, the left one tall and the right one half as tall, each a smooth unbranched ribbed column with a rounded top like two upright cucumbers, small spines

rows.name: Fat Stubby
rows.subject: a short very fat young cactus, a thick rounded green column almost as wide as a barrel with deep ribs and one small round knob near its top, small spines

rows.name: Hook Arm
rows.subject: a green ribbed cactus pillar with a single long branch on its right side only: the branch grows out sideways, bends down, then curls up again like a fishhook; the left side of the pillar is plain, small spines

rows.name: Tall Barrel
rows.subject: a taller old barrel cactus shaped like a short thick column, leaning slightly to one side, ribbed green with curved yellow spines and a ring of yellow flowers on top

rows.name: Red Fishhook
rows.subject: a round fat barrel cactus covered in dense long curved red hooked spines, ribbed green underneath, a ring of small yellow fruits on top

rows.name: Triple Clump
rows.subject: a clump of three small round barrel cacti of different sizes huddled close together, ribbed green with curved yellow spines, a few small pink flowers

rows.name: Golden Ball
rows.subject: a low perfectly round golden barrel cactus, its green ribs covered in dense golden-yellow spines, a pale woolly patch on top

rows.name: Wrinkled Barrel
rows.subject: an old shrunken barrel cactus, its whole round body wrinkled and sagging with deep folds, dull olive green turning yellow-brown towards the bottom, curved yellow spines, two small orange flowers on top

rows.name: Budding Stalk
rows.subject: a spiky blue-green agave plant with thick pointed leaves fanning out from the ground and a short thick flower stalk like a giant asparagus spear just starting to rise from its centre

rows.name: Striped Agave
rows.subject: a spiky agave plant with broad thick pointed leaves fanning out from the ground, each blue-green leaf edged with a wide creamy white stripe along both sides

rows.name: Wide Sprawl
rows.subject: a wide open agave plant with long narrow blue-green leaves arching outwards and drooping at their tips down to the ground, wider than it is tall

rows.name: Pup Cluster
rows.subject: a spiky blue-green agave plant with thick pointed leaves and three small baby agave rosettes growing close around its base

rows.name: Withered Leaves
rows.subject: an old agave plant dying back: the outer leaves dry, brown and collapsed flat on the ground, only the upright leaves in the centre still blue-green and spiky

rows.name: Windblown Twigs
rows.subject: a dry dead desert shrub swept by the wind: all its grey-brown twigs bent over and pointing the same way to one side

rows.name: Bare Stump
rows.subject: the dead stump of a desert shrub: a short thick gnarled grey-brown woody base with only a few short broken branch stubs sticking up

rows.name: Thorn Tangle
rows.subject: a dense round ball of tangled dead thorny branches still rooted in the ground, dark brown, with many long sharp thorns

rows.name: Forked Sticks
rows.subject: a sparse dead desert shrub of just three tall thin bare forked sticks rising from one root, pale grey-brown

rows.name: Last Leaves
rows.subject: a dry dead desert shrub of tangled grey-brown twigs with a few dry orange-brown leaves still clinging to the tips of the twigs

rows.name: Lightning Split
rows.subject: a dead desert tree struck by lightning: the thick grey trunk split down the middle into two halves leaning apart, burnt black inside the split, a few bare broken branches

rows.name: Leaning Snag
rows.subject: a dead desert tree leaning far over to one side, most of its branches gone, one long bare twisted branch reaching out, cracked grey bark

rows.name: Hollow Stump
rows.subject: the tall broken stump of a thick dead desert tree, its top snapped off in jagged splinters, a dark hollow hole in the trunk and two short broken branch stubs, cracked grey bark

rows.name: Twisted Spiral
rows.subject: a dead desert tree whose trunk twists round like a corkscrew, bare smooth sun-bleached pale silver wood, a few short curling bare branches at the top

rows.name: Wide Antlers
rows.subject: a dead desert tree with a short thick trunk that forks into two big limbs spreading wide to both sides like antlers, each ending in many bare twigs, cracked grey bark

rows.name: Double Trunk
rows.subject: a mesquite tree with two twisted brown trunks rising apart from the ground in a V shape, joined above by one broad low crown of small green leaves

rows.name: Hanging Pods
rows.subject: a wide low mesquite tree with a twisted trunk and a broad crown of small green leaves, with bunches of long pale yellow bean pods hanging down under the leaves

rows.name: Wind Bent
rows.subject: a mesquite tree bent by the wind: the twisted trunk leaning to one side and the whole crown of small green leaves swept out the same way

rows.name: Knotted Trunk
rows.subject: a very old mesquite tree with a thick knotted twisted trunk, several bare dead branches sticking out of a thin crown that has green leaves on one side only

rows.name: Yellow Catkins
rows.subject: a wide low mesquite tree with a twisted trunk and a broad crown of fresh light green leaves covered with fuzzy pale yellow catkin flowers

rows.name: Gold Crown
rows.subject: a slender palo verde tree with smooth green bark in full bloom: the whole crown one cloud of bright yellow blossoms, hardly any green leaves showing

rows.name: Green Broom
rows.subject: a bare palo verde tree in the dry season: a slender smooth green trunk and a crown that is a broom of many fine bare green twigs

rows.name: Vase Stems
rows.subject: a palo verde tree with five slender smooth green stems rising from the ground and spreading apart like a vase, a light airy crown of tiny leaves and a few yellow blossoms

rows.name: Wide Shade
rows.subject: an old palo verde tree with a short thick smooth green trunk and a very wide low crown spreading far to both sides, the branch tips drooping, tiny leaves and scattered yellow blossoms

rows.name: Thin Sapling
rows.subject: a young palo verde sapling: one thin crooked smooth green trunk with a small sparse tuft of tiny leaves and a few yellow blossoms at the top

rows.name: Flat Slab
rows.subject: a small flat low slab of layered sandstone, much wider than it is tall, orange and tan

rows.name: Split Stone
rows.subject: a small rounded sandstone rock cracked into two halves that still lean against each other with a dark gap between them, orange and tan

rows.name: Sharp Shard
rows.subject: a small sharp angular pointed shard of sandstone standing upright, orange and tan with flat broken faces

rows.name: Cobble Heap
rows.subject: a small heap of five rounded sandstone cobbles of different sizes piled together, orange and tan

rows.name: Smooth Egg
rows.subject: a small smooth water-worn river stone: a rounded oval sandstone pebble lying on its long side, matte pale tan rock with one darker orange band across it and a few tiny pits

rows.name: Table Top
rows.subject: a big sandstone rock shaped like a table: a wide flat top overhanging narrower undercut sides, orange and tan with cracks

rows.name: Leaning Fin
rows.subject: a big tall narrow slab of sandstone standing on edge and leaning to one side like a fin, orange and tan with cracks

rows.name: Three Stack
rows.subject: three flat sandstone rocks stacked on top of each other by nature, the biggest at the bottom, orange and tan with cracks

rows.name: Honeycomb Rock
rows.subject: a big rounded sandstone rock weathered full of round holes and hollow pockets like a honeycomb, orange and tan

rows.name: Banded Rock
rows.subject: a big rounded dome of sandstone with strong horizontal bands of pale cream and dark red-orange running across it

rows.name: Split Giant
rows.subject: a huge sandstone boulder split by one wide vertical crack into two halves leaning slightly apart, layered orange and tan bands

rows.name: Window Arch
rows.subject: a huge sandstone boulder with a natural round hole worn right through its middle like a window, layered orange and tan bands

rows.name: Capped Spire
rows.subject: a tall natural rock pillar, a desert hoodoo: a rough lumpy uneven column of weathered layered sandstone, crooked and irregular, wider at its foot, with one big rounded brown boulder balanced on its top, orange and tan bands, cracks

rows.name: Tumbled Heap
rows.subject: a heap of four huge angular sandstone boulders tumbled against each other, layered orange and tan bands

rows.name: Peeling Dome
rows.subject: a huge wide smooth rounded dome of sandstone, wider than it is tall, with thin curved shells of rock peeling off its surface, orange and tan bands

rows.name: Longhorn Skull
rows.subject: a big bleached longhorn cattle skull with very long horns sweeping far out to both sides and curving up at the tips

rows.name: Broken Horn
rows.subject: a big bleached one-horned cow skull: one long curved horn on its left side, and on its right side only a short jagged broken stump where the other horn snapped off

rows.name: Cracked Brow
rows.subject: a big bleached cow skull with short thick horns, a long crack running down its forehead and a jagged hole broken in the bone above one eye socket

rows.name: Tipped Skull
rows.subject: a big bleached cow skull with long curved horns lying tipped over on its side, resting on one horn, the other horn pointing up

rows.name: Open Jaw
rows.subject: a big bleached cow skull with long curved horns turned three-quarters to the side, its long lower jawbone hanging wide open below the upper jaw, two rows of big flat teeth showing in the gaping mouth

rows.name: Long Snout
rows.subject: a small bleached coyote skull with a long narrow snout and sharp teeth, sitting upright and turned three-quarters

rows.name: No Jaw
rows.subject: the top half of a small bleached animal skull resting flat on the ground: the cranium with big round eye sockets and a row of upper teeth along its bottom edge

rows.name: Upside Down
rows.subject: a small bleached animal skull lying upside down, its teeth pointing up

rows.name: Curled Horns
rows.subject: a small bleached animal skull with two little curled horns, lying on its side

rows.name: Staring Skull
rows.subject: a small bleached animal skull sitting upright and facing straight forward, two dark empty eye sockets, a cracked snout

rows.name: Rib Arch
rows.subject: half a bleached cattle ribcage lying on the ground: a row of six long curved rib bones arching up side by side from a short piece of spine that lies flat, like the bare frame of a small boat, a couple of loose bones beside it

rows.name: Crossed Bones
rows.subject: two long bleached leg bones lying crossed over each other with a few small bones scattered close around them

rows.name: Curved Spine
rows.subject: a long bleached animal spine lying in a curve: a row of vertebrae with a few short rib stubs still attached

rows.name: Hip Bone
rows.subject: a big bleached pelvis bone with two long leg bones lying beside it

rows.name: Bone Mound
rows.subject: a tall mound of many mixed bleached bones piled up: ribs, leg bones and vertebrae heaped together

rows.name: Single Tuft
rows.subject: a young unbranched joshua tree: one single straight shaggy trunk covered in dry dead brown leaves, topped by one big spiky round green leaf ball, like a shaggy pole with a pom-pom

rows.name: Cream Blossoms
rows.subject: a joshua tree with a shaggy trunk and several branches ending in spiky green leaf balls, in bloom: a big creamy white flower cluster standing on the tip of every branch

rows.name: Candle Arms
rows.subject: a neat symmetrical joshua tree: a straight shaggy brown trunk with four shaggy brown branches, two on each side, each branch curving out and then straight up like the prongs of a fork, each ending in one spiky round green leaf ball

rows.name: Hanging Limb
rows.subject: a joshua tree with a shaggy trunk and several branches ending in spiky green leaf balls, one big limb broken and hanging down dead with dry brown leaves

rows.name: Dying Joshua
rows.subject: a dying joshua tree: bare grey leafless branches with strips of dry bark, only one branch still ending in a spiky green leaf ball

rows.name: Red Berries
rows.subject: a round dense desert bush of small dusty green leaves dotted all over with clusters of small bright red berries

rows.name: Leggy Bush
rows.subject: a scraggly uneven desert bush: bare woody brown stems showing at the bottom, lopsided tufts of small dusty green leaves on top

rows.name: White Flowers
rows.subject: a round dense desert bush of small dusty green leaves sprinkled with many small white flowers

rows.name: Flat Cushion
rows.subject: a low flat desert bush hugging the ground: one wide shallow mound of dense small dusty green leaves, three times wider than it is tall, its twigs touching the ground all along its edge

rows.name: Half Dry
rows.subject: a round desert bush that is half dead: one side dry bare brown twigs, the other side still dense with small dusty green leaves

rows.name: White Fluff
rows.subject: a sparse creosote bush of thin dark branches with tiny yellow-green leaves, covered in small fuzzy white seed balls

rows.name: Tall Wands
rows.subject: a tall narrow creosote bush: long thin dark branches rising straight up like wands, tiny yellow-green leaves and a few small yellow flowers near the tips

rows.name: Open Ring
rows.subject: a wide low creosote bush that has grown outwards in a ring: thin dark leafy branches leaning out all around an empty bare middle, tiny yellow-green leaves

rows.name: Full Flower
rows.subject: a creosote bush of thin dark branches in full bloom, covered all over in many small bright yellow flowers among tiny yellow-green leaves

rows.name: Drought Twigs
rows.subject: a creosote bush in a drought: mostly bare thin dark branches with only a few tiny olive-brown leaves left

rows.name: Silver Dome
rows.subject: a small round brittlebush that is all leaf: a low neat dome of hundreds of tiny soft silvery grey-green oval leaves on thin woody twigs, like a little grey shrub

rows.name: High Daisies
rows.subject: a small brittlebush shrub: a low dome of tiny silvery grey-green leaves at the bottom, and standing high above it a dozen bright yellow daisy flowers, each on its own very long thin bare straight stalk, the stalks as tall as the dome itself

rows.name: Dry Seedheads
rows.subject: a small brittlebush after flowering: a low dome of soft silvery grey-green leaves with dry brown seed heads on thin bare stems above it

rows.name: Few Daisies
rows.subject: a small sparse uneven brittlebush: a few loose tufts of silvery grey-green leaves and only four bright yellow daisy flowers on thin bare stems

rows.name: Yellow Blanket
rows.subject: a wide low round brittlebush completely covered in bright yellow daisy flowers packed side by side like a yellow blanket, only a few small silvery grey-green leaves peeking out along its bottom edge

rows.name: Long Skirt
rows.subject: a tall desert fan palm whose trunk is completely hidden under a thick shaggy skirt of dry straw-brown dead fronds hanging all the way down to the ground, a crown of big green fan-shaped leaves on top

rows.name: Skinny Palm
rows.subject: a very tall thin desert fan palm with a clean bare rough grey-brown trunk from the ground to the top and a small round crown of green fan-shaped leaves at the very top

rows.name: Short Stout
rows.subject: a young short stout desert fan palm: a thick stubby rough trunk and a big wide crown of green fan-shaped leaves close to the ground, a few dead brown fronds under it

rows.name: Hanging Fruit
rows.subject: a tall desert fan palm with a slender rough trunk, a short skirt of dead brown fronds and a crown of big green fan-shaped leaves, with long arching stalks hanging out of the crown carrying clusters of small black fruit

rows.name: Ragged Crown
rows.subject: a storm-battered desert fan palm with a slender rough trunk: only a few tattered green fan-shaped leaves left in its crown, some broken and hanging down, a thin ragged skirt of dead brown fronds

rows.name: Bare Whips
rows.subject: an ocotillo plant in the dry season: a spray of many long thin bare grey leafless thorny whip-like stems fanning up from one point on the ground, their tips bare and pointed

rows.name: Leafy Green
rows.subject: an ocotillo plant after rain: a spray of long thin whip-like stems fanning up from one point on the ground, every stem covered from bottom to top in small bright green leaves

rows.name: Curling Whips
rows.subject: an ocotillo plant: a spray of long thin thorny grey-green whip-like stems from one point on the ground, several of them bent and curling over sideways at the top, a few tipped with a red flower cluster

rows.name: Red Torches
rows.subject: a big dense ocotillo plant: a spray of very many long thin thorny grey-green stems fanning up from one point on the ground, every stem tipped with a long bright red flame-shaped flower spike

rows.name: Young Ocotillo
rows.subject: a small young sparse ocotillo plant: only four long thin thorny grey-green whip-like stems fanning up and apart from one point on the ground in a narrow V, lots of empty space between them, each tipped with a small red flower cluster

rows.name: Open Box
rows.subject: a plain old western wooden wagon toppled over on its long side, seen from a high three-quarter angle: the open top of the long plank box turned towards us so that we look into its dark empty inside, two big wooden spoked wagon wheels with iron tyres still on their axles up in the air on top, one of them broken with a gap in its rim, the wooden tongue pole sticking out to the side, warm brown weathered wood with dark iron straps, no cloth, no canvas, no cover, no rags, nothing hanging, nothing else

rows.name: Belly Up
rows.subject: a plain old western wooden wagon lying upside down on its back, seen from a high three-quarter angle: the flat underside of the long plank box turned up to the sky with two dark wooden axle beams and a long pole between them lying across it, two big wooden spoked wagon wheels with iron tyres still on the far ends of the axles, one of them broken with a gap in its rim, the wooden tongue pole sticking out to the side, warm brown weathered wood with dark iron straps, no cloth, no canvas, no cover, no rags, nothing hanging, nothing else

rows.name: One Wheel
rows.subject: a plain old western wooden wagon toppled over on its long side, seen from a high three-quarter angle: the long box of warm brown wooden planks with dark iron straps, its underside turned towards us with two dark wooden axle beams and a long pole between them, only one big wooden spoked wagon wheel with an iron tyre left, up in the air on the end of one axle, the other axle's end bare, the wooden tongue pole sticking out to the side, no cloth, no canvas, no cover, no rags, nothing hanging, nothing else

rows.name: Burnt Wreck
rows.subject: a burnt-out old western wooden wagon toppled over on its long side, seen from a high three-quarter angle: every plank of the long box charred black and dark grey like charcoal with cracked burnt edges and streaks of pale grey ash, its underside turned towards us with two blackened axle beams and a long pole between them, two scorched black spoked wagon wheels with iron tyres up in the air on top, one of them broken with a gap in its rim, cold and dead, no flames, no smoke, no glow, no cloth, nothing hanging, nothing else

rows.name: No Wheels
rows.subject: a plain old western wooden wagon box toppled over on its long side, seen from a high three-quarter angle: the long box of warm brown wooden planks with dark iron straps, its underside turned towards us with two dark wooden axle beams and a long pole between them, the bare wooden ends of the two axle beams sticking up on top, the wooden tongue pole sticking out to the side, no cloth, no canvas, no cover, no rags, nothing hanging, nothing else
